info.description:
Acquia Cloud API

# Compatibility

## Stability

The response for all resource endpoints includes an `X-CloudAPI-Stability` header that indicates what changes, if any, Acquia will make to the resource and how changes will be communicated.

Contact Support:
 Name: Customer Experience Engineering (CXE)

item.name: Create a new Private Network

request.description:
Creates a new Private Network with optional subresource configuration.

This comprehensive endpoint allows you to create a private network and optionally configure
its subresources (connections, VPNs, VPC peers, ingress, and isolation) during the initial creation.

**Subresource Creation:**
- **Connections**: Configure CIDR block and egress access settings
- **VPNs**: Create one or more VPN connections with tunnel configurations
- **VPC Peers**: Create one or more VPC peering connections
- **Ingress**: Configure ingress access rules and privacy settings
- **Isolation**: Configure compute and network isolation flags

All subresources are optional. If not specified during creation, they can be configured later
using their respective endpoints.
